feature: MEAS dimension alignment snap and spacing review

full.note: Final Shift-latch refinement additionally covered by focused suite

behavior: 8px parallel baseline alignment in same saved plane
Shift latches initial dominant plane axis until released
Selected anchor remains fixed while normal spacing preserves tangent placement
Group apply is one atomic command and Undo without kernel calls
Changing spacing invalidates its prior preview
limitations: Viewport text bounds are estimates, not PDF font collision certification
Spacing does not guarantee elimination of all long-label or extension-line crossings
No cross-plane or nonparallel automatic organization
Text and baseline still move together
